question: Military action against Saudi Oil Pipeline (East-West) by November 30?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Saudi Arabia's East-West crude pipeline or its pumping stations are hit by an air strike or surface-to-surface missile or drone strike by 11:59 PM Riyadh time on 11/30/2026. Resolves with Polymarket market military-action-against-saudi-oil-pipeline-east-west-by-november-30.

history.rationale: 11/07/2026: the crowd's price 21.0% with the horizon's known bias taken out (23 days to go, from the backtest's 30-day map), giving 13.1%. No independent news view. The lead-lag test found no indicator that moves before Polymarket, so the price is the best public starting point.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes. Our last number was 13.1%. Brier 0.755. Polymarket closed the market resolved Yes on 11/13/2026. Saudi Arabia itself reported a drone attack on the East-West pipeline in the Madinah region on 11/09/2026 that caused a limited fire (Al Jazeera, aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/9/saudi-arabia-reports-new-attack-on-key-east-west-pipeline). Later Houthi claims on Nov 12, 13 and 17 were not confirmed by Saudi officials. Miss: we shaded the crowd's 21% down to 13.1% for horizon bias, and the strike came two days later. The pipeline was hit in April and September too, so the base rate was higher than the horizon map implied.
